info.title: KNAPP KiSoft Mock API
info.description:
Mock server simulating the KNAPP KiSoft One API, limited to the message subset in scope for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma per the **HOST Interface Specification One API Appendix P000-013061, version V4.0 (2026-06-10)**, valid in combination with Product One API 2.11.3 (2026-02-27). Only the in-scope HOST → KiSoft One calls are exposed. Bearer token required (OAuth 2.0, HIS Appendix §2.4.2).

**Field usage notation (HIS Appendix §4.1)** — incoming (HOST → KiSoft One): `[REQ]` = technically required, omission returns format error E-AKO-GENR-0002 and is modelled here as OpenAPI `required`; `[MAN]` = optional in the schema but logistically mandatory for this warehouse, modelled as an optional property whose description is prefixed `[MAN]`; empty = optional. Outgoing (KiSoft One → HOST): `[REQ]` = always transmitted, modelled as `required`.

**Conformance to the official product API.** Version 4.0.0 was reconciled field-by-field against **KiSoft One API 2.12.2** (`openapi (1).json`). Attribute names, datatypes and constraints (`maxLength`, `pattern`, `format`, `minimum`) now follow the official specification. Where the HIS Appendix and the official API disagree on a **name or datatype**, the official API is followed and the field description records the correction - the appendix cannot rename a field the product does not have. Where they disagree on **structure**, the official API is likewise followed, but those three cases are called out as open points for KNAPP because they change the wire format: `processedStock` and `inventoryRequestLine` are single objects (not arrays), and `areaWeights` is a `oneOf` over two mutually exclusive variants. Scope, field usage ([REQ]/[MAN]/[NIS]) and enumerated values remain governed by the HIS Appendix, which narrows the product API for this warehouse.

**Fields not used by this warehouse** are shown grey and struck through in the HIS Appendix. They are reproduced here with OpenAPI `deprecated: true` (Swagger UI renders them struck through, matching the document) and are never listed in a schema's `required` array. Two distinct meanings apply, per direction:
- Incoming (HOST -> KiSoft One), description prefix `[NIS]`: not in scope. The HOST **must not transmit** the field; doing so may cause unpredictable behaviour and system errors (HIS Appendix §4.1.1).
- Outgoing (KiSoft One -> HOST), description prefix `[not logistically relevant]`: KiSoft One **still transmits** the field - removing data fields from reply messages is not permitted at KNAPP for upgradability reasons (HIS Appendix §4.1.2) - but it carries no logistical relevance for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma and the HOST should ignore it.

A schema is marked `deprecated` as a whole when it is struck through at every point it is used.

**Enumerations** carry only the values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma per HIS Appendix §4.2 — the Product One API defines further values that are not configured for this warehouse.

**Operations under tag "Mock OData Read (NOT KiSoft API)" are mock-only inspection GETs — they are not part of the KiSoft One Product API (HIS Appendix §2.3.1: KiSoft exposes no GET endpoints).** Operations marked `deprecated` with an `[OUT OF SCOPE …]` summary are messages the HIS Appendix marks **NO**; they are retained for negative testing only and must not be used in production integration.

Lifecycle events POST callbacks to IBM APIC server-side (e.g. **https://apitest-awe.volvo.com/vgcd/external/plwms5d.srv.volvo.com/wms/oneapi/v1/_webhooks/stockReceived**). Use **Webhooks (outgoing)** with wait=true to see the APIC response in the reply.

BusinessCase.description: businessCase values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.1). Defines how KiSoft One processes the order/request (permitted conveyors and workflows) and is used to group/filter on the GUI and in statistics. If the HOST omits the value, KiSoft One populates the DEFAULT value defined per message in the Product One API.

StockLockReason.description: stockLockReasons values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.3).

ArticleFeature.description: articleFeatures values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.4). **4.0.0:** HIS Appendix §4.2.4 lists `COOLING_REQ`; KiSoft One API 2.12.2 defines the predefined value as `COOLING_REQUIRED`. The official value is used.

LoadCarrier.description: loadCarrier values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.5). FULL/HALF/QUATER/EIGHTH are OSR plastic load units with 1/2/4/8 slots; EUR_PALETTE is a pallet; SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE are carton or plastic load units. Note: QUATER is spelled as in the specification.

StockType.description: stockType values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.6). STANDARD = normal articles; CD2 = crossdocking; RETURNS = returned articles (WMS usage only); REJECTED = articles rejected during receiving.

StockQuality.description: stockQuality values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.7).

ControlFlag.description: controlFlags values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.8). CHECK_BY_HOST = load unit has to be manually checked; LIDDING = has to be lidded; STRAPPING = has to be strapped; BUFFER = processed load unit has to be stored in a buffer system; ROUTE_ASSISTANCE = storage orders only, requests feedback about possible entry points; MULTI_PHASE = order is a multi-phase order.

ProcessingStatus.description: processingStatus values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.9). NEW = initially created; RELEASE_READY = OutboundDelivery ready for release (WMS only, OutboundDeliveryReply — out of scope for this project); STARTED = started and active; MP_WAIT = load unit of a multi-phase order buffered in the AeroBot system; PROCESSED = all tasks processed, content final (picking completed, released to final check); MP_RELEASED = buffered multi-phase load unit finally released from the AeroBot system; FINISHED = completed; CANCELLED = cancelled and will not be completed.

ProcessingResult.description: processingResult values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.10). See the specification for the full semantics of each value.

CreatedBy.description: createdBy values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.11). HOST = created because of a message from the higher-level system; SYSTEM = created for a KiSoft-internal reason (e.g. a load unit booked LOST); USER = created by a user action in KiSoft (e.g. creation via GUI).

ContentType.description: contentType values configured for VOLVO TRUCKS Tacoma (HIS Appendix §4.2.12). EMPTY = empty load unit without any content; STOCK = load unit with stock that can be picked from; GOODS_OUT = load unit with or without already picked stock, stock not available for picking.

StationAction.description: Station action that triggered a configurable station reply for a goods-out order (HIS Appendix §4.3.2). DIVERT = the load unit was diverted at the station; THROUGH = it passed through; PROCESS = it was processed at the station.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization per HIS Appendix §2.4.2.1 (RFC 6749). The Authorization Server authenticates the client system and issues the access token; the HOST Interface acts as Resource Server and validates the token and its scopes before business processing. The token representation (opaque or JWT) is defined by the Authorization Server configuration. All communication is TLS-encrypted (HIS Appendix §2.1, §2.4.1 — public certificates).
